hints.title: Tiered Frequency Grouping
hints.text: Group elements by their current count frequency level so that the most frequent and most recently inserted elements are instantly accessible.

hints.title: Dual Lookup and Frequency Level Chains
hints.text: Keep track of each integer count alongside a map from each frequency tier to an ordered collection of elements reaching that tier.

hints.title: FreqStack Operations Blueprint
hints.text: In push(val): increment count[val]. If count[val] > max_freq, update max_freq. Append val to group[count[val]]. In pop(): retrieve last val from group[max_freq], decrement count[val], if group[max_freq] is empty decrement max_freq, return val.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Constant time hash lookups and list tail removals guarantee O(1) per operation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining a single sorted frequency container requires O(log N) updates per push and pop.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual grouping structures yield O(1) time complexity by duplicating references across tiers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understanding frequency level bucket stacks for O(1) tie-breaking by recency.

solutions.approach: JavaScript Map Tiering with Array Stacks
